interactables.label: Rest until morning
interactables.text: A worn canvas tent. The flap is rolled back; your bedroll is inside.

interactables.label: Inspect lantern
interactables.text: An oil lantern on a crooked post. It will burn through the night.

interactables.label: Tend the fire
interactables.text: You feed the fire a few sticks. The embers brighten.

interactables.label: Fish from the platform
interactables.text: You cast from the weathered platform. Something stirs under the lily pads.

interactables.label: Examine the ruins
interactables.text: Two walls and a lintel, taken back by moss. Someone hung a lantern here recently.

interactables.label: Gather branches
interactables.text: You pull dry branches from beside the hollow log.

interactables.label: Gather branches
interactables.text: You snap a few fallen rowan twigs. The berries can wait.

interactables.label: Gather stones
interactables.text: Loose stones around the mossy boulders. Good for a fire ring.

interactables.label: Cut the big oak
interactables.text: You work at the old oak for a while. It is far from done.
